motion.hover_interactions: Buttons and cards scale up slightly (hover:-translate-y-1).
motion.framer_motion_entrances: Use staggered fade-in-up animations for hero content and tariff cards using framer-motion.
motion.tab_indicator: Animate the active tab background smoothly using framer-motion layoutId.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text is used over the primary blue (#0033ff) and accent orange (#FF7A00).
accessibility.focus_states: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#FF7A00] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 to all buttons and inputs.
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='contract-button').

image_urls.description: Energetic woman in yellow jacket holding a smartphone, perfect for a dynamic telecom hero image.
Wi-fi router to represent the Fiber product/service.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific fast-loading telecom e-commerce page. Focus on high-performance 2D framer-motion micro-interactions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Develop a React SPA (.js, not .tsx) using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Build a sticky glass header (`backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80`) with the Logo (left), Nav links (center), and 'Mi cuenta' outline button (right). Hide Nav on mobile behind a hamburger menu.

Hero Section: Use a 12-col grid. Left side has massive 'Outfit' heading (`text-5xl md:text-7xl`), subtext, and two buttons: Primary 'Ver tarifas' (#0033ff) and Secondary 'Comprobar fibra' (#FF7A00). Right side contains the energetic hero image.

Tariffs Grid: Use customized shadcn Tabs to switch between Móvil, Fibra, Satélite, TV. The cards must have huge prices (`text-6xl font-black`), feature list with Lucide Check icons, and a 'Contratar' CTA. Highlight the main plan with a solid primary blue background, scaling it up slightly, and adding a 'Más popular' badge.
Fiber Coverage Checker: Full width section with solid #0033ff background. Include a simple address input and 'Comprobar fibra' button. Make it spacious.
Trust Row: 4 items (Icon + text). Include 'Portabilidad gratis', 'Alta 100% online', 'App GoRoky', and 'Atención 24/7'. DO NOT INCLUDE 'Sin permanencia'.
SEO Marquee: Implement `react-fast-marquee`. Display scrolling Spanish cities (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Alicante, etc.) using massive outline text (e.g., text-transparent text-stroke).
Footer: Dark theme (#0A0A0A) with white text. Include links and legal text: 'TRAMILEX GLOBAL SERVICE SL · B21796925'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT use 'sin permanencia' in any copy, as fiber does have a commitment period. CRITICAL RULE.
The website must look hyper-professional, mimicking the bold and spacious aesthetic of www.wom.cl.
Do not use generic centered layouts for the entire page. Rely on asymmetrical grids.
Implement extreme spacing (e.g., py-24, gap-8) to give a 'spacious' ('amplia') premium feel.
NEVER use generic placeholder images or text like 'Lorem ipsum'. Use Spanish language for all text.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements to support testing.
Install and use `framer-motion` for entry animations and interactive tab highlights.
Use standard Tailwind classes. Avoid custom CSS files unless necessary for the marquee outline effect.
